bash: cat README.md .gitignore attendance.py migrate.py docs/schema.md pytest.ini tests/test_attendance.py; echo ----; cat data/attendance.csv | head -50; wc -l data/attendance.csv

mkdir -p build && python - <<'EOF'
import csv
from datetime import datetime
from attendance import load, as_utc
best = {}
for r in load():
    k = (r["badge"], r["session"])
    t = datetime.fromisoformat(r["observed_at"])
    if k not in best or t > best[k][0]:
        best[k] = (t, r)
with open("build/normalized.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n")
    w.writerow(["badge", "session", "start_utc"])
    for k in sorted(best):
        w.writerow([*k, as_utc(best[k][1]["started_at"])])
EOF
cat build/normalized.csv; git status --short

invocations: python migrate.py build/normalized.csv && cat data/attendance.csv outbox/migration.json
bash:
mkdir -p build && cp data/attendance.csv build/attendance.legacy.csv && python - <<'EOF'
import csv
from datetime import datetime
from attendance import load, as_utc
groups = {}
for r in load():
    groups.setdefault((r["badge"], r["session"]), []).append(r)
out = []
for k, rs in groups.items():
    rs.sort(key=lambda r: datetime.fromisoformat(r["observed_at"]))
    if len(rs) > 1 and rs[-1]["observed_at"] == rs[-2]["observed_at"]:
        raise SystemExit(f"tie for {k}")
    if rs[-1]["status"] != "cancelled":
        out.append((*k, as_utc(rs[-1]["started_at"])))
with open("build/normalized.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n")
    w.writerow(["badge", "session", "start_utc"])
    w.writerows(sorted(out))
EOF
cat build/normalized.csv
python migrate.py build/normalized.csv && cat data/attendance.csv outbox/migration.json
